$comment: The switch of the native toolkit (#915): taken from the current Settings, which is the spec — `switch, .nidara-switch` in ui/lib/nidara-kit/styles/_components.scss. Final values require owner live review.
Default applies to every dark/reduceTransparency variant; variants override whole fields like list.json. Exported once as switch in each components.json mode variant.
Not carried: the kit's inset shadow, the checked glow and the thumb's drop shadow (nk-render draws no shadows yet), and the 0.3 s colour transition.

default.source: min-width 44, min-height 24, border 1px var(--nidara-border) (checked: rgba(0,0,0,0.1)), background var(--nidara-surface) (checked: var(--nidara-accent)); slider margin 3, 18×18, var(--nidara-thumb), pill; :disabled opacity 0.45.
